Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpreted the context of “former Governor of Arkansas.” Despite WebSurfer finding that Suettinger served during the Clinton administration, the Planner incorrectly linked this to the then–Arkansas governor (Mike Huckabee) instead of recognizing that “former Governor of Arkansas” refers to President Bill Clinton. This led to a premature and incorrect conclusion.
